subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 executable GitHub Action updates as one grouped security-sensitive dependency change after exact-head checks settle?
rationale: The PR changes code executed with repository tokens, scanning privileges, publishing credentials, or agent secrets and carries a protected security label, so final trust acceptance belongs to a maintainer.

options.title: Verify and approve together
options.body: Confirm each SHA maps to the stated upstream release, review the sensitive release deltas, and merge after the rebased exact-head gates pass.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex updates from routine setup and labeling actions to narrow trust review and rollback.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Keep the existing revisions until complete exact-head workflow evidence or upstream review is available.

recommendation.title: Verify and approve together
recommendation.body: Confirm each SHA maps to the stated upstream release, review the sensitive release deltas, and merge after the rebased exact-head gates pass.
